items.title: Meta’s Muse Can Book Your Vacation—and Travel Stocks Are Paying the Price
items.summary: Expedia, Booking, and other travel stocks fell on worries that artificial personal assistants could siphon off some of their business.

items.title: Meta’s Muse Drags Down Stocks That Depend on ‘Consumer Inertia’
items.summary: Shares of major banks, insurers and online travel agencies slid on Tuesday as investors fear that tools like Meta Platforms Inc.’s personal AI agent could disrupt businesses that benefit from so-called consumer inertia, the tendency to keep buying something out of habit even when a better alternative exists.

items.title: Meta’s Muse Jumps to the Top of the Apple Store—and Triggers a Panic in the Stock Market
items.summary: Tuesday’s selloff echoes the garden-variety selloffs earlier this year, driven by anxiety over AI displacing traditional industries.

items.title: Expedia Group Stock: Is EXPE Outperforming the Consumer Cyclical Sector?
items.summary: Expedia Group has outpaced the consumer cyclical sector, and analysts remain moderately optimistic about the stock’s outlook.

items.title: 1 Safe-and-Steady Stock to Research Further and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: A stock with low volatility can be reassuring, but it doesn’t always mean strong long-term performance. Investors who prioritize stability may miss out on higher-reward opportunities elsewhere.
